item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i bzlog gzhung me yi 'khor lo'i 'gres byang mchong lnga'i le'u
item.coloph: ces snyigs dus kyi 'gro la dpal du shar ba'i rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i bzlog (zlog) pa'i 'gres ('dres) byang 'di nyid/ me gsas rnam rol gar dbang bdud 'dul snying po dang snying grogs dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs dang*/ phyis su rang gam du gnas pa'i btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs kyis nye myur gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ tshe dbang rol gar g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis deng sang snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro la phan par sems pa'i lung bstan dpa' bo chen po'i zhal nas yang yang gsungs pa bzhin du/ shar grol smin gling rlung sems zung 'jug gi bcad rgya'i thun mtshams su dge bar spel lo//
